I posted the list in #strategic-pod as a reply to Nadia. It has seven Vantorre Group tickets, each with a source, plus notes on what needs checking before it goes to Mateo.

- **#8841** appears three times with different status and description: closed 7/1 (pod channel), open 5/4 (digest), and a new carrier-portal submission 9/30 (digest). It may have been reopened or the number reused. I couldn't tell from these sources.
- **PD-8841, PD-4418, INC-4821, VT-55120** are listed once each with their sources. The PD-4418 digest doesn't name the account, so I attributed it to Vantorre Group from the cheat sheet, and said so.

I only searched channels Nadia can see, so tickets raised elsewhere aren't included.
